items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1971-04-08
items.q: Was he a friend of Dandy Lewis and those guys?

ctx.x: Big star-frog. Was he a friend of Dandy Lewis and those guys? No, that's right.
Uh, Willie, I called his name. He used to play. Willie Cornish? That's who played tuba. Willie Cornish played tuba?
